thread:
Maya: Quick pulse — post-launch dashboard looks weird for the 'launch_posts' cohort. CPA is down but raw leads are down too. Anyone else seeing an attribution shift?
Jon: Yup, noticed yesterday evening. UTM_source counts are lower than expected, but sessions are flat.
Priya: saw a spike in 404s on the landing page at ~18:20 UTC yesterday. Could be a redirect flake causing the UTM drop.
Samir: adding context: Dedicated routing for inbound leads had a backlog during that window (queue depth spiked). Could be duplicate suppression/ingestion lag.
Kai: cc @analytics-bot can you confirm whether the cohort window changed on the dashboard refresh?
analytics-bot: dashboard-refresh: "Postlaunch Performance" refreshed at 1789998720. Cohort window set to 7d sliding by default. No manual overrides detected.
Maya: thanks — can we get raw event counts for clicks -> form_submit for 3/20 18:00-19:00 UTC?
Jon: running quick query, will paste results.
Jon: ```sql
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) as minute, sum(case when event='click' then 1 else 0 end) as clicks, sum(case when event='form_submit' then 1 else 0 end) as submits
FROM marketing_events
WHERE campaign='launch_posts' AND ts >= '2026-03-20 18:00:00' AND ts < '2026-03-20 19:00:00'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute;
```
Jon: quick summary — clicks ~820, submits ~9 (last week same window: submits ~28).
Priya: that ratio is way off. Browser console logs point to a widget script failing to initialize in some sessions (403 on widget CDN). Pushing fix now.
Samir: also saw a backlog on the inbound routing topic: kafka consumer lag hit 35k for ~12m. That could cause the telemetry/attribution records to arrive late and be de-duped by the later pipeline.
Maya: action items: 1) Priya to confirm widget CDN fix rollout and compute expected catch-up. 2) Samir to surface consumer lag timeline + verify reprocessing won't break attribution. 3) Jon to run a backfill query for 18:00-20:00 tonight and tag cohort.
Priya: rolling fix to CDN at 18:45 UTC, will monitor. ETA for recovery metrics ~30m after rollback.
Samir: consumer lag started 18:05, peaked 18:17, recovered by 18:30. I'll open an ops thread with offsets and reprocessing plan.
Jon: will schedule a backfill job and share query + checksum.
Kai: to capture in the weekly KPI deck: include a footnote on 3/20 attribution blip + remediation steps. Also recommend flagging the launch-posts channel for any downstream customers we notified.
Maya: agreed. If backfill recovers the missing submits, we should treat this as an ingestion/infra issue in the postmortem; if not, treat as landing page UX loss.
Priya: quick note — landing widget fix applied, monitoring console: error rate dropped from ~12% -> ~0.5%.
analytics-bot: backfill-job queued (job_id: bf-1789998801). ETA ~45m.
Maya: thanks team. I'll update the KPI doc and ping stakeholders once backfill completes. :thumbsup:
Kai: nice work — can we add a short automated check to the dashboard that alerts when clicks->submits conversion drops >50% vs baseline? Would catch this earlier.
Samir: yes, will draft the alert and post the rule in #eng-ops.
Maya: perfect. Closing this thread for now, will reopen if backfill doesn't reconcile.
